q CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF BUSINESS, CONSUMER SERVICES AND HOUSING AGENCY + GAVIN NEWSOM, GOVERNO
4 BOARD OF REGISTERED NURSING
\ CONSUMER 1747 N. Market Blvd. Suite 150, Sacramento, CA 95834

AFFAIRS P (916) 322-3350 F (916) 574-8637 | www.rn.ca.gov

March 13, 2026

NICOLAS HERNANDEZ

RE: MR. KIFLE GASHIE JIKAMO
Dear NICOLAS HERNANDEZ:

This is in response to the information that has been provided to the Board of Registered
Nursing.

We are carefully evaluating this matter and appropriate action will be taken. It is
important that the BRN Enforcement Division staff is able to keep in contact with you. If
the address you provided as a contact changes, please notify the Enforcement Division as
soon as possible in writing to:

Board of Registered Nursing
Attn: Enforcement Division
P.O. Box 944210
Sacramento, CA 94244-2100

Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention and the opportunity to be of
assistance.

Sincerely,

BOARD OF REGISTERED NURSING

Complaint No. 4002026006579

400, CMPLREC1.040218
